patterns: APPSC asks direct SES-figure items: RBKs 10,778 (SES 2023-24), Rythu Bharosa ₹13,500, egg rank 1st, oil palm output 17.81 lakh t, seafood export share 36%, cropping intensity 1.25, cultivated area 37%.
Expansion/acronym items recur: RySS = Rythu Sadhikara Samstha, APCNF = Community Managed Natural Farming; Panta Sanjeevani = farm ponds; 'white gold' = cotton.
Two-statement items on AP ranks (oil palm productivity 1st, mango 2nd) and institute-location items (VBRI Vijayawada, Indo-Israel CoE Palnadu).
Year-specific SES numbers are the trap: APPSC always ties a figure to a named survey year.
App MCQs go far deeper into 2025-26 current data (budgets, NMNF figures, PMMSY splits, aqua tariffs) and many multi-statement items; APPSC mostly uses single-figure recall.
